title: Heat objects with the microwave by placing them inside first
description: Use this when a task requires heating an object and the microwave is available.
content: To heat an object in the microwave, first open the microwave, move the object into it, and then use the heat action; heating will only succeed when the object is actually inside the microwave.

source.task_query: Your task is to: heat some plate and put it in sidetable.

title: Cool objects using a fridge before placing them
description: Use this when a task requires cooling an object, such as a pan, before moving it to a destination.
content: To cool an object, first take the object from its current location, then go to a fridge and use the "cool [object] with [fridge]" action. Ensure the fridge is open before attempting to cool the object.

source.task_query: Your task is to: cool some pan and put it in countertop.

title: Verify object placement after moving items
description: Use this after moving objects to confirm the task is progressing correctly.
content: After moving an object to a destination, check the destination's contents to confirm the object arrived successfully. Also check your inventory to verify you are not carrying anything before picking up the next object.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two newspaper and put them in coffeetable.

title: Search systematically through storage locations when looking for a target object
description: Use this when the required object is not immediately visible and must be located by exploring the environment.
content: When searching for an object, methodically check each cabinet, drawer, fridge, shelf, sinkbasin, and stoveburner by opening closed containers and examining their contents. Do not skip locations or assume an object is absent without checking, as the target may be in an unexpected place such as a stoveburner.
